models_evaluated: Bayesian logistic LASSO regression (Horseshoe+ prior, Metropolis-Hastings)

links.outcome: Predictive uncertainty differences across race, cancer type, and stage subgroups
links.effect: Predictive uncertainties significantly differed across race, cancer type, and stage. Overall AUROC was similar for BLLR (0.807) and LASSO (0.806); subgroup discrimination was not reported.
links.quote: BLLR uncertainties were stratified by different patient subgroups, demonstrating that predictive uncertainties significantly differ across race, cancer type, and stage.

unlisted_practices: Bayesian logistic regression to give patient-level predictive uncertainty distributions
Abstaining from automatic classification of predictions that are too uncertain

screen.reason: The study evaluates Bayesian predictive uncertainty quantification to identify cases too uncertain to classify and explore differences across demographic subgroups on retrospective EHR data.

primary.practice: uncertainty estimation and abstention / identifying predictions too uncertain for automated classification
